baseline_note: Measured 2026-10-12 with one relevance question per candidate, protocol openai, endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 (local ninfer), model systemone-decision-v7. The opaque choice shape it replaced scored right 6, wrong 0, undecided 1 (p50 227 ms, p95 228 ms) on the same endpoint and model. The three source-code-graph cases were dropped on 2026-10-16 when those tools stopped being deferred; all three had scored right, so the remaining cases keep their measured results. The python_execution case went the same day, when Python moved into the always-declared code tool.
